description: Travel demand for public transportation is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Teanhong zhao. This data includes travel demand by public transportation (buses, metros, and taxis) in Shenzhen. The collected data was from December 1, 2018, to December 31, 2018. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 372774811 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
